scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction, from the electricity customer's seat: ss 16(1), (4), 16A(1)-(2), 17, 20(1A), (3), 22(2), 23(1C), 27G(1), (5), 27K, 27M(2), (5), 27N(1)-(2), (4), 27O(2)-(4), 44(2)(b), (4), 64(1) (working day) and Schedule 6 paras 2, 5, 7(4)-(5), 8(3)(a), (4), 10(4) of the revised text as at 24 July 2026. Bank holidays are an input. Left out on purpose: licensing and the regulators, penalties (except their amount), standards of performance, the renewables obligation, consents, meters (Schedule 7), and the other Parts.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass has been run (see INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md); two of its assertions are expected to fail (the clear-days reading of working days' notice). The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 17(1)(c) for a maintained connection only after notice; other s 17 grounds need none.
forks.F2: N working days' notice: act on or after the N-th working day after the notice (the tester's clear-days reading left failing).
forks.F3: s 20(3): whole 50p sums, whole three-month periods.
forks.F4: s 23(1C): 12 months beginning with, day before the corresponding date.
forks.F5: Sch 6 para 2: a late payment does not end the power.
forks.F6: Sch 6 para 2(2)(b): notice may run during the 28 days; earliest day the later of demand + 29 and the notice period.
forks.F7: Entry on the day of the action, with two working days' notice and the document.
forks.F8: ss 27G-27O and 44 read as for the Gas Act 1986.
